title: How populous is each country?
prompt: Place each country from smallest population to largest.

items.label: Iceland
items.fact: One of the least densely populated countries in Europe.

items.label: Ireland
items.fact: Ireland's population is only now nearing its pre-famine 1840s peak.

items.label: Sweden
items.fact: A large country by area but modest by headcount.

items.label: Canada
items.fact: The second-largest country by land, yet fewer people than California.

items.label: Japan
items.fact: Japan's population is shrinking and aging faster than almost anywhere.

items.label: India
items.fact: India recently overtook China as the most populous country.
